title: In vivo, in vitro and in silico anticancer investigation of fullerene C(60) on DMBA induced breast cancer in rats.
authors: Beyaz, Seda; Aslan, Abdullah; Gok, Ozlem; Uslu, Harun; Agca, Can Ali; Ozercan, Ibrahim Hanifi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究富勒烯C60对DMBA诱导乳腺癌的保护作用，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: AIMS: The aim of the study was to determine the protective and therapeutic effect of fullerene C(60) nanoparticle on DMBA-induced breast cancer in rats. MAIN METHODS: In vitro cell viability was determined by the WST-1 test. In vivo analysis was performed in female Wistar Albino rats. The expression of caspase-3, Bcl-2, Nrf-2, NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, COX-2, p53, IL-6, IL-1alpha ve p38alpha (MAPK) proteins were assessed by western blotting. Furthermore, malondialdehyde (MDA), glutathione (GSH), catalase activity (CAT), total protein levels and DNA damage were investigated. In addition, tissues were evaluated by histopathologically. In in silico analysis, the binding affinities of the fullerene C(60) nanoparticle to transcription factors such as caspase-3, Bcl-2, Nrf-2, NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, COX-2, VEGF and Akt were demonstrated by molecular docking. KEY FINDINGS: Treatment of MCF-7 cells at various concentrations of fullerene C(60) (0.1 to 100 mg/ml) inhibited cell viability in a dose dependent manner. Fullerene C(60) treated rats exhibited considerable increase in the level of caspase-3 while decrease in the level of pro-survival protein Bcl-2. Bcl-2, NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, COX-2, IL-6, IL-1alpha and p38alpha (MAPK) protein expression levels and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels were decreased in the C(60) + DMBA groups compared to the DMBA group. It was observed that caspase-3, Nrf-2 and p53 protein expression levels, glutathione (GSH) level, catalase activities (CAT) and total protein levels increased significantly which was further confirmed through the resulting DNA fragmentation. SIGNIFICANCE: In silico assays, fullerene C(60) has been observed to have similar affinity to some crystal ligands, especially against cancer.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在确定富勒烯C(60)纳米颗粒对DMBA诱导的大鼠乳腺癌的保护和治疗作用。主要方法：通过WST-1试验测定体外细胞活力。体内分析在雌性Wistar白化大鼠中进行。通过蛋白质印迹法评估caspase-3、Bcl-2、Nrf-2、NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、COX-2、p53、IL-6、IL-1alpha和p38alpha（MAPK）蛋白的表达。此外，还研究了丙二醛（MDA）、谷胱甘肽（GSH）、过氧化氢酶活性（CAT）、总蛋白水平和DNA损伤。另外，对组织进行了组织病理学评估。在计算机模拟分析中，通过分子对接展示了富勒烯C(60)纳米颗粒与转录因子如caspase-3、Bcl-2、Nrf-2、NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、COX-2、VEGF和Akt的结合亲和力。主要发现：以不同浓度的富勒烯C(60)（0.1至100 mg/ml）处理MCF-7细胞，以剂量依赖方式抑制细胞活力。富勒烯C(60)处理的大鼠表现出caspase-3水平显著升高，而促生存蛋白Bcl-2水平降低。与DMBA组相比，C(60) + DMBA组中Bcl-2、NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、COX-2、IL-6、IL-1alpha和p38alpha（MAPK）蛋白表达水平以及丙二醛（MDA）水平降低。观察到caspase-3、Nrf-2和p53蛋白表达水平、谷胱甘肽（GSH）水平、过氧化氢酶活性（CAT）和总蛋白水平显著增加，这通过产生的DNA片段化进一步得到证实。意义：在计算机模拟试验中，富勒烯C(60)被观察到与某些晶体配体具有相似的亲和力，尤其是在抗癌方面。
